source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action change in context partner; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context partner returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role analyst or auditor, except for action change; a trusted delete prefers allow at priority 80. Action approve in context partner prefers deny at priority 70. Role auditor or context internal prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

rendered_bundle: Verified decision list. Find a line whose stated field conditions all match the input, then return its label. Unstated fields can have any value. Matching lines agree.

Execution checklist: First evaluate every complete rule condition. If any true rule abstains, return uncertain. Otherwise collect required and forbidden labels. Conflicting required labels, or a required label that is forbidden, returns uncertain; one valid required label wins. If there is no required label, discard forbidden preferences and choose the unique highest-priority preference. A top-priority tie or no remaining preference returns uncertain.
